description: This file contains utility functions and classes for debugging, profiling, and analyzing the structure of PyTorch models, particularly focusing on distributed and sharded modules in the Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) context.

classes.name: SimpleProfiler
classes.description: A utility class for profiling different types of distributed operations, with methods to reset, profile, and dump profiling results.

classes.name: SimpleProfiler.Type
classes.description: An enumeration of profiling types such as all-gather, resharding, and data transfer directions.

methods.name: _get_sharded_module_tree_with_module_name_to_fqns
methods.description: Analyzes a PyTorch model to produce a textual tree representation of its sharded modules and a mapping from module names to their parameter FQNs, used for debugging and visualization of model sharding.
